briefs.title: History Honors 250
briefs.summary: HISTORY's multiplatform America-250 initiative (Feb 2025 - Aug 2026) led by Eli Lehrer; includes Kevin Costner's The West and Sitting Bull.

commissioners.name: Elaine Frontain Bryant
commissioners.title: Executive Vice President & Head of Programming, A&E and Lifetime
commissioners.remit: Programming lead across A&E and Lifetime, including unscripted / true-crime docuseries.

recent_commissions.title: Crime in Progress
recent_commissions.desc: A&E two-season order; raw-footage (bodycam, surveillance) true-crime series following investigations from 911 call to verdict; premiered 1 Jan 2026.

commissioners.notes: Title taken from A&E press release republished by Morty's TV (Dec 2025), which lists her in the release credits; release does not literally say she greenlit it. No official A+E pitch route found.

commissioners.name: Eli Lehrer
commissioners.title: Executive Vice President and Head of Programming, The HISTORY Channel
commissioners.remit: Programming lead for HISTORY nonfiction series and specials.

recent_commissions.title: History's Deadliest with Ving Rhames
recent_commissions.desc: 10-part Propagate Content series on the deadliest people, places and events; premiered 26 Jan 2026. Lehrer credited as executive producer for The HISTORY Channel.

recent_commissions.title: Modern Marvels: WWII (wt)
recent_commissions.desc: Three-part Hearst Media Production Group revival of Modern Marvels on WWII machines and innovations; spring 2026. Lehrer quoted as EVP & Head of Programming.

commissioners.notes: Newest dated evidence of the title is Oct 2025 (Modern Marvels release, ~12.5 months old); Dec 2025 release credits him as HISTORY EP but without his title. Modern Marvels: quoted on the greenlight, not explicitly named as greenlighting it.
